verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents RealtimeKit with prebuilt meeting UI and SDKs for web and mobile, plus a Core SDK for custom builds, so official multi-platform client SDKs exist. The evidence does not name iOS and Android separately or show that the SDKs share one session/track model served by one backend. The SFU's 'standard HTTPS APIs and WebRTC' from native apps is a protocol-level building block, not an SDK. missing for 10: explicit iOS and Android SDK documentation, evidence of a consistent session and track model across platforms, hands-on corroboration of one backend serving all clients.

support.subject: As a developer, official client SDKs cover web, iOS, and Android with the same session and track model, so one backend serves every platform

citations.quote: Use prebuilt meeting UI and SDKs for web and mobile.
Use [RealtimeKit Core SDK](/realtime/realtimekit/humans/core/) to build every screen and interaction yourself.
